data.title: Erasmus+ exchange: submit Learning Agreement
data.summary: The University of Beispielstadt International Office congratulates you on your Erasmus+ nomination for winter 2026/27 at the University of Musterholm. You must submit your signed Learning Agreement by 15 May 2026.
data.explanation: You have been nominated for an Erasmus+ exchange semester. To go ahead, upload your signed Learning Agreement to the Mobility-Online portal by 15 May 2026. Without it, the university cannot forward your application to the host university. If you have questions about the agreement, contact the International Office.
